citations.claim: total energy rises with no work source, exceeding bound at first violating step
vy magnitude grows ~1.74 per step vs analytic g*dt~0.29, injecting spurious KE

counterfactual.change: reduce dt from 0.029522205733329192 to 0.001 keeping steps=2 and all else identical; removes spurious gain so no violation

explanation: Shrunk case has one free body, no walls, no contacts, controller disabled and zero work, so only gravity acts. Semi-implicit Euler under constant gravity should update vy by exactly g*dt (~0.29/step) with no energy creation, but vy grows by ~1.74/step (6x too large) while vx is constant, so KE and total energy grow ~56J/step and breach energy_bound in 2 steps. The large dt (0.0295) at speed ~40 triggers 41-43 substeps per step; the substepped gravity/position update injects energy. Same scenario with dt=0.001 shows no growth and no violation, confirming a large-dt integration energy error, not a physical source.
vision_note: The lone blue circle falls downward and drifts slightly right from step 0 to step 2 with no walls, waypoints, or other bodies visible. Its fall distance grows between frames with no collision or control interaction seen, matching a free-fall under gravity only.
